verdict: Strongly toward the stop: at 2R the target has to come first in 33 % of the replays that hit one side; it did in 14 % (target first 4.7 % vs stop first 28.5 %).
verdict_notes: 66.8 % of the replays hit neither by 4:00 PM; the price at 4:00 PM decides those.

note: A simulation built from LUV's own last 59 full sessions. It is not a prediction: earnings, news and halts can do things those sessions never did. Same seed, same numbers.
